searchText: Hello all 👋 , I have a question on p2p peer scoring. - I am testing on kurtosis with Lighthouse and Prysm nodes. - During testing I have been starting and stopping a node often. - After a while I notice that the Prysm node refuses new connections, but Lighthouse continues to work - from Prysm kurtosis logs: ``` [cl-4-prysm-geth] [2026-05-30 10:50:55] DEBUG p2p: Could not connect with peer error=peer connect: failed to dial: failed to dial 16Uiu2HAmHzBkRq62…: all dials failed * [/ip4/172.16.0.7/udp/31123/quic-v1] context deadline [cl-4-prysm-geth] [2026-05-30 10:51:06] DEBUG p2p: Downscore peer newScore=3 … reason=connectionError ``` this is for a dial attempt whilst the peer is offline. Since Lighthouse and Prysm behave differently, I was wondering if there is any consensus on the correct behaviour in this situation? Should peers be penalised for being offline? Many thanks! excerpts.content:
Hello all 👋 , I have a question on p2p peer scoring. 
- I am testing on kurtosis with Lighthouse and Prysm nodes. 
- During testing I have been starting and stopping a node often. 
- After a while I notice that the Prysm node refuses new connections, but Lighthouse continues to work
- from Prysm kurtosis logs:
```
[cl-4-prysm-geth] [2026-05-30 10:50:55] DEBUG p2p: Could not connect with peer error=peer connect: failed to dial: failed to dial 16Uiu2HAmHzBkRq62…: all dials failed  * [/ip4/172.16.0.7/udp/31123/quic-v1] context deadline
  [cl-4-prysm-geth] [2026-05-30 10:51:06] DEBUG p2p: Downscore peer newScore=3 … reason=connectionError
```
this is for a dial attempt whilst the peer is offline. 

Since Lighthouse and Prysm behave differently, I was wondering if there is any consensus on the correct behaviour in this situation? Should peers be penalised for being offline? 
Many thanks!
